audit.whatIsWrong: Missing-interactions flagged that Soraka sustains through chip damage via Astral Infusion (W) and Wish (R), but itemization advice only said "his duo's sustain" without naming which abilities anti-heal answers.
audit.why: Both W and R are HP-cost heals — Grievous Wounds cuts both, and the trade math (she pays HP per W cast) is already the lane's stated win condition, so itemization should say it plainly.
